Receipt Total Premium = the total on the Confirmation page

CIBO > Transaction Management row: Ins. Co. Allianz with agency badge Serba Sentral, Payment Paid, Transaction Status "Insurance created"; Payment Mode the same as a Lonpac FPX payment on /ia/ (today bare "Fiuu"; the SA format is QA-Issue EAINT-12566, On Hold: not a 12406 failure)
CIBO Transaction Details: Cover Note No and Policy No filled (not "-"); Payment Ref ID with 'SFX' like a Lonpac FPX payment, with Allianz's own insurer code (code recorded, Q30)
e-Certificate and Receipt buttons shown; e-Certificate opens a document for this vehicle plate
